# wasm-image-filters

> Integer-only RGBA image filters that give bit-identical results natively and in WebAssembly, with Gaussian blur, Sobel edges, sepia, contrast and a filter pipeline Rust crate `trysac-wasm-image-filters`, library `wasm_image_filters`, MIT licensed,
> Rust >= 1.88 (edition 2024), standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
